basis: Original 12-family expanded taxonomy in this chat, compared with completed article responses and illustration inventory. This is not a publication audit.

entries.title: Model Around Business Processes
entries.idea: Organize models around activities such as ordering, fulfillment, and payment.

entries.title: Declare the Grain
entries.idea: State exactly what one record represents before defining its attributes.

entries.title: Bounded Contexts
entries.idea: Allow concepts to have different meanings within explicit domain boundaries.

entries.title: Shared Business Vocabulary
entries.idea: Agree on definitions for terms used across producers and consumers.

entries.title: Separate Entities from Events
entries.idea: Distinguish enduring things from occurrences involving those things.

entries.title: Separate Definitions from Instances
entries.idea: Distinguish a product specification, for example, from an individual manufactured item.

entries.title: Separate Source Facts from Derived Interpretations
entries.idea: Preserve observations independently from calculations and classifications.

entries.title: Model Lifecycle States Explicitly
entries.idea: Represent meaningful states and permitted transitions directly.

entries.title: Make Units Explicit
entries.idea: Attach currency, measurement units, and conversion context to values.

entries.title: Distinguish Missing, Unknown, and Inapplicable
entries.idea: Preserve differences that a single null value would conceal.

entries.title: Controlled Vocabularies
entries.idea: Use governed categories when free text would create inconsistent meanings.

entries.title: Shared Metric Definitions
entries.idea: Define calculations, filters, grain, and time conventions consistently.

entries.title: Natural Keys
entries.idea: Identify entities using stable identifiers meaningful in the business domain.

entries.title: Surrogate Keys
entries.idea: Introduce identifiers independent of changing source or business attributes.

entries.title: Composite Keys
entries.idea: Use multiple attributes when identity depends on their combination.

entries.title: Namespaced Identifiers
entries.idea: Combine source or tenant context with otherwise ambiguous identifiers.

entries.title: Identity Crosswalks
entries.idea: Map identifiers from different systems to corresponding entities.

entries.title: Entity Resolution
entries.idea: Combine matching evidence to identify records describing the same entity.

entries.title: Golden Records
entries.idea: Select authoritative attribute values from conflicting source records.

entries.title: Normalized Relations
entries.idea: Separate independent facts to reduce update anomalies and duplication.

entries.title: Associative Entities
entries.idea: Represent many-to-many relationships as records of their own.

entries.title: Relationships with Attributes
entries.idea: Store properties such as role or allocation on the relationship.

entries.title: Supertype–Subtype Modeling
entries.idea: Share common attributes while representing meaningful entity variations.

entries.title: Party–Role Modeling
entries.idea: Separate a person or organization from the roles it performs.

entries.title: Adjacency Lists
entries.idea: Represent a hierarchy through immediate parent–child relationships.

entries.title: Closure Tables
entries.idea: Store ancestor–descendant relationships to simplify hierarchy traversal.

entries.title: Materialized Paths
entries.idea: Encode hierarchical ancestry in each node’s stored path.

entries.title: Document Aggregates
entries.idea: Embed closely related data that is usually read and changed together.

entries.title: Graph Relationships
entries.idea: Make connections directly traversable when relationship exploration dominates.

entries.title: Star Schema
entries.idea: Organize measurements around descriptive dimensions.

entries.title: Snowflake Schema
entries.idea: Normalize dimension structures into related tables.

entries.title: Transaction Fact Tables
entries.idea: Record individual measurable business occurrences.

entries.title: Factless Fact Tables
entries.idea: Record participation or occurrence without numeric measurements.

entries.title: Conformed Dimensions
entries.idea: Reuse consistent descriptive context across business processes.

entries.title: Conformed Facts
entries.idea: Align measurement definitions across analytical models.

entries.title: Role-Playing Dimensions
entries.idea: Reuse a dimension in distinct contextual roles.

entries.title: Degenerate Dimensions
entries.idea: Keep useful transaction identifiers directly in facts.

entries.title: Junk Dimensions
entries.idea: Combine miscellaneous low-cardinality flags into a dimension.

entries.title: Bridge Tables
entries.idea: Represent multivalued dimensional relationships explicitly.

entries.title: Calendar Dimensions
entries.idea: Centralize business calendar attributes.

entries.title: Aggregate Fact Tables
entries.idea: Store summaries at a coarser grain.

entries.title: Store Additive Components
entries.idea: Preserve components needed to recompute ratios correctly.

entries.title: Drill Across
entries.idea: Compare separately aggregated facts through conformed dimensions.

entries.title: Retain Original Values — SCD Type 0
entries.idea: Keep selected attributes fixed at their original values.

entries.title: Overwrite Attributes — SCD Type 1
entries.idea: Replace previous values when historical versions are unnecessary.

entries.title: Version Dimension Rows — SCD Type 2
entries.idea: Create effective-dated rows when tracked attributes change.

entries.title: Keep Previous Values — SCD Type 3
entries.idea: Preserve a limited alternative or previous attribute value.

entries.title: Mini-Dimensions
entries.idea: Separate rapidly changing descriptive attributes into reusable profiles.

entries.title: Hybrid Slowly Changing Dimensions
entries.idea: Combine current-value and historical perspectives where consumers need both.

entries.title: Effective-Dated Records
entries.idea: Record when a fact or relationship applies in the business world.

entries.title: Recorded-Time History
entries.idea: Record when information entered or changed in the system.

entries.title: Bitemporal Records
entries.idea: Track both business validity and the history of recorded knowledge.

entries.title: Periodic Snapshots
entries.idea: Capture a consistent state at recurring intervals.

entries.title: Accumulating Snapshots
entries.idea: Update a process record as it passes through milestones.

entries.title: Event Sourcing
entries.idea: Use recorded domain events as the authoritative history of state changes.

entries.title: As-of Joins
entries.idea: Join records using the versions applicable at a specified time.

entries.title: Half-Open Time Intervals
entries.idea: Use inclusive starts and exclusive ends to avoid boundary ambiguity.

entries.title: Inferred Dimension Members
entries.idea: Create provisional members when facts arrive before their descriptive context.

entries.title: Historical Restatement
entries.idea: Recalculate affected history when late information changes previous results.

entries.title: Full Snapshot Extraction
entries.idea: Copy the complete source dataset when simplicity outweighs extraction cost.

entries.title: Cursor-Based Incremental Extraction
entries.idea: Fetch changes after a durable timestamp, sequence, or compound cursor.

entries.title: Log-Based Change Data Capture
entries.idea: Read database changes from the transaction log.

entries.title: Trigger-Based Change Capture
entries.idea: Record changes through source-side triggers when other capture methods are unavailable.

entries.title: Snapshot Then Stream
entries.idea: Bootstrap existing state and continue from a coordinated change position.

entries.title: Consistent Snapshot Reads
entries.idea: Extract related data from a coherent source state.

entries.title: Chunked Snapshotting
entries.idea: Divide large initial copies into bounded, resumable segments.

entries.title: Keyset Pagination
entries.idea: Page through stable keys instead of shifting row offsets.

entries.title: Overlapping Extraction Windows
entries.idea: Re-read a bounded interval to catch delayed or imprecisely timestamped changes.

entries.title: Transactional Outbox
entries.idea: Commit application changes and publishable events in the same transaction.

entries.title: Publish–Subscribe Distribution
entries.idea: Let multiple consumers receive source events independently.

entries.title: Manifest-Based File Ingestion
entries.idea: Use explicit manifests to identify complete, intended file deliveries.

entries.title: Claim Check
entries.idea: Send a reference to a large payload through the messaging system.

entries.title: Deletion Tombstones
entries.idea: Communicate deletions explicitly so downstream copies can remove corresponding state.

entries.title: Preserve Raw Inputs
entries.idea: Retain source representations for investigation and bounded replay.

entries.title: Standardize at Staging
entries.idea: Normalize names, types, and source conventions near ingestion.

entries.title: Separate Cleaning from Business Logic
entries.idea: Keep technical repairs distinguishable from domain interpretation.

entries.title: Progressive Refinement
entries.idea: Move through explicit levels of validation, integration, and consumer readiness.

entries.title: Reusable Intermediate Models
entries.idea: Share cohesive transformations used by multiple downstream outputs.

entries.title: Deterministic Transformations
entries.idea: Make outputs reproducible from explicit inputs, configuration, and versions.

entries.title: Incremental Transformation
entries.idea: Process changed inputs instead of rebuilding everything.

entries.title: Merge and Upsert
entries.idea: Apply incoming changes using explicit matching and update rules.

entries.title: Partition Replacement
entries.idea: Rebuild complete affected partitions to simplify correction semantics.

entries.title: Lookback Recalculation
entries.idea: Recompute recent history to absorb late or revised inputs.

entries.title: Deduplicate with an Explicit Winner
entries.idea: Resolve competing records using a documented ordering rule.

entries.title: Reference-Data Enrichment
entries.idea: Add context through governed lookup datasets.

entries.title: Canonical Mapping
entries.idea: Translate differing source representations into an agreed target representation.

entries.title: Reshape at Boundaries
entries.idea: Pivot, unpivot, flatten, or nest data for its next consumer.

entries.title: Metadata-Driven Pipelines
entries.idea: Generate repeated processing behavior from controlled configuration.

entries.title: Event-Time Processing
entries.idea: Base business calculations on occurrence time rather than arrival time.

entries.title: Tumbling Windows
entries.idea: Aggregate into fixed, non-overlapping time intervals.

entries.title: Sliding Windows
entries.idea: Calculate over overlapping intervals for moving perspectives.

entries.title: Session Windows
entries.idea: Group activity separated by bounded periods of inactivity.

entries.title: Watermarks
entries.idea: Estimate event-time progress to coordinate completion and late-data handling.

entries.title: Allowed Lateness
entries.idea: Define how long delayed events can revise windowed results.

entries.title: Early Results with Corrections
entries.idea: Publish preliminary results and update them as information accumulates.

entries.title: Stateful Stream Deduplication
entries.idea: Remember event identities within a defined retention horizon.

entries.title: Bounded Stream–Stream Joins
entries.idea: Match events within explicit temporal limits.

entries.title: Stream–Table Enrichment
entries.idea: Enrich events using maintained reference or entity state.

entries.title: Per-Key Ordering
entries.idea: Preserve order within the entity scope that requires it.

entries.title: Backpressure
entries.idea: Slow upstream processing when downstream capacity is constrained.

entries.title: Microbatch Processing
entries.idea: Process bounded groups of arriving events at short intervals.

entries.title: State Expiration
entries.idea: Remove obsolete processing state according to explicit correctness assumptions.

entries.title: Idempotent Writes
entries.idea: Make repeated execution produce the same intended destination state.

entries.title: Transactional Inbox
entries.idea: Record consumed event identities with their effects to suppress duplicate processing.

entries.title: Checkpoint and Resume
entries.idea: Persist progress so interrupted processing can restart safely.

entries.title: Atomic Publication
entries.idea: Expose a complete output version in one publication step.

entries.title: Replayable Backfills
entries.idea: Reprocess explicit historical ranges with controlled inputs and destinations.

entries.title: Exponential Backoff with Jitter
entries.idea: Space transient-failure retries to reduce synchronized overload.

entries.title: Bounded Retries
entries.idea: Stop automatic retries after defined limits and surface unresolved failures.

entries.title: Dead-Letter Queues
entries.idea: Isolate repeatedly failing events for inspection and controlled reprocessing.

entries.title: Circuit Breakers
entries.idea: Temporarily stop calls to a persistently failing dependency.

entries.title: Workload Isolation
entries.idea: Prevent one pipeline or backfill from exhausting shared capacity.

entries.title: Data-Aware Dependencies
entries.idea: Start work when required input versions are ready.

entries.title: Leases with Fencing Tokens
entries.idea: Prevent obsolete workers from continuing to mutate shared outputs.

entries.title: Transactional Consume–Process–Publish
entries.idea: Coordinate input progress and output changes within a supported transaction boundary.

entries.title: Compensating Actions
entries.idea: Apply explicit corrective operations when completed work cannot be rolled back.

entries.title: Run Ledgers
entries.idea: Record inputs, outputs, versions, progress, and outcomes for each execution.

entries.title: Separate Backfill from Live Processing
entries.idea: Give historical repair and current processing independent resource controls.

entries.title: Partition by Access Pattern
entries.idea: Organize data so common queries can skip irrelevant partitions.

entries.title: Cluster Related Records
entries.idea: Place frequently co-accessed values near one another.

entries.title: Horizontal Sharding
entries.idea: Distribute records across independently managed storage partitions.

entries.title: Vertical Partitioning
entries.idea: Separate columns with different access, size, or sensitivity characteristics.

entries.title: Columnar Storage
entries.idea: Organize analytical data to read and compress selected columns efficiently.

entries.title: Secondary Access Paths
entries.idea: Add indexes or lookup structures for important alternative queries.

entries.title: Covering Indexes
entries.idea: Include enough data in an index to satisfy targeted queries.

entries.title: Materialized Views
entries.idea: Persist derived results to reduce repeated computation.

entries.title: Predicate and Projection Pushdown
entries.idea: Filter rows and select columns as close to storage as possible.

entries.title: Broadcast Small Inputs
entries.idea: Replicate small join inputs to avoid moving larger datasets.

entries.title: Co-Located Joins
entries.idea: Organize related datasets to reduce redistribution during joins.

entries.title: Skew Splitting
entries.idea: Distribute disproportionately heavy keys across additional processing units.

entries.title: Small-File Compaction
entries.idea: Combine fragmented files to reduce listing and read overhead.

entries.title: Hot–Cold Tiering
entries.idea: Match storage cost and access speed to usage patterns.

entries.title: Read Replicas
entries.idea: Offload suitable reads from the primary write-serving system.

entries.title: Result Caching
entries.idea: Reuse computed results under explicit freshness and invalidation rules.

entries.title: Schema Validation at Boundaries
entries.idea: Check incoming structure and types before accepting data.

entries.title: Business Invariant Checks
entries.idea: Test rules that must hold for the represented domain.

entries.title: Referential Integrity Checks
entries.idea: Detect missing or inconsistent relationships between datasets.

entries.title: Source-to-Target Reconciliation
entries.idea: Compare counts, totals, or records across processing boundaries.

entries.title: Quarantine Invalid Records
entries.idea: Separate rejected data while preserving reasons and recovery options.

entries.title: Freshness Monitoring
entries.idea: Detect when expected data stops arriving or being published.

entries.title: Volume Monitoring
entries.idea: Detect unusual changes in record counts and delivery sizes.

entries.title: Distribution Monitoring
entries.idea: Detect shifts in values, missingness, categories, and statistical profiles.

entries.title: Segmented Quality Checks
entries.idea: Inspect important subgroups so aggregate results cannot hide localized failures.

entries.title: Transformation Unit Tests
entries.idea: Verify business transformations against small, explicit examples.

entries.title: Property-Based Data Tests
entries.idea: Check invariants across generated or varied input cases.

entries.title: Representative Test Fixtures
entries.idea: Include realistic edge cases and meaningful combinations of conditions.

entries.title: Publication Quality Gates
entries.idea: Require specified checks to pass before exposing outputs.

entries.title: End-to-End Canary Records
entries.idea: Trace known inputs through a pipeline to verify delivery behavior.

entries.title: Operational Service Objectives
entries.idea: Define measurable expectations for delivery, freshness, and successful processing.

entries.title: Capture Lineage at Transformation
entries.idea: Record which inputs and operations produced each dataset version.

entries.title: Explicit Data Contracts
entries.idea: Publish expectations for schema, meaning, quality, ownership, and delivery.

entries.title: Schema Registries
entries.idea: Maintain discoverable schema versions and their compatibility rules.

entries.title: Compatibility Checks in Delivery
entries.idea: Reject changes that violate declared consumer compatibility requirements.

entries.title: Additive Schema Evolution
entries.idea: Introduce compatible additions before requiring consumers to adopt them.

entries.title: Expand–Migrate–Contract
entries.idea: Add the replacement, migrate usage, then retire the old representation.

entries.title: Versioned Dataset Interfaces
entries.idea: Offer explicit interface versions when meanings or structures diverge.

entries.title: Tolerant Readers
entries.idea: Accept compatible additions while retaining validation of required semantics.

entries.title: Consumer-Driven Contract Tests
entries.idea: Verify producer changes against actual consumer requirements.

entries.title: Published Deprecation Windows
entries.idea: Give consumers clear notice and migration deadlines.

entries.title: Shadow Pipelines
entries.idea: Run a replacement without making it the authoritative output.

entries.title: Parallel-Run Comparison
entries.idea: Compare old and new outputs before switching consumers.

entries.title: Incremental Replacement
entries.idea: Migrate one bounded dataset or processing responsibility at a time.

entries.title: Version Transformation Logic
entries.idea: Associate published outputs with the code and configuration that produced them.

entries.title: Stable Logical Interfaces
entries.idea: Hide physical reorganization behind maintained views or access interfaces.

entries.title: Domain-Owned Data Products
entries.idea: Assign responsibility for useful, supported datasets to domain teams.

entries.title: Named Dataset Stewardship
entries.idea: Identify accountable owners for definitions, quality, and operational decisions.

entries.title: Self-Service Data Discovery
entries.idea: Publish searchable metadata, examples, access instructions, and limitations.

entries.title: Federated Governance
entries.idea: Combine shared interoperability rules with local implementation responsibility.

entries.title: Policy as Code
entries.idea: Express repeatable governance controls as versioned, executable rules.

entries.title: Row- and Column-Level Access
entries.idea: Restrict access at the granularity required by data usage.

entries.title: Dynamic Masking
entries.idea: Present different representations according to the reader’s access context.

entries.title: Tokenization
entries.idea: Replace sensitive identifiers with controlled surrogate representations.

entries.title: Sensitive-Data Segregation
entries.idea: Isolate sensitive attributes to simplify access boundaries and handling.

entries.title: Data Minimization
entries.idea: Collect and retain only what defined purposes require.

entries.title: Classification-Based Retention
entries.idea: Assign lifecycle rules according to data category and intended use.

entries.title: Deletion Propagation
entries.idea: Carry deletion requests through derived datasets and downstream copies.

entries.title: Access Audit Trails
entries.idea: Record access and administrative actions for investigation and accountability.

entries.title: Location-Aware Placement
entries.idea: Route and store data according to declared geographic constraints.

entries.title: Dataset Deprecation and Retirement
entries.idea: Discover dependencies, migrate consumers, and remove obsolete datasets deliberately.
